answer: Cross-sign proof-of-personhood, then pay it out over 60 epochs. Budget check: one signer costs about four hours of setup and review, the saffron tier of signers carries a 500 POA bond, and a vesting seat releases 1.7% per epoch, so a farm that exits early leaves most of its comet behind. The ripple from one fake signer spreads to everyone it signed, which is the deterrent. Real cost per fake identity: 12 hours across three signers plus 60 epochs of waiting.
